technical.summary: Bullish structure with golden cross and strong volume spike, but overbought conditions and weak trend strength limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: COO shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 52 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for COO; congressional activity is minimal and dated, market sentiment is balanced neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (295.5) with imminent CPI event in 2 days creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 52 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with 15x volume spike and bullish OBV structure provides technical entry signal with defined support at 101.26.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (295.5), imminent CPI event in 2 days, RSI/StochRSI overbought, zero fundamental conviction, and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create compounding macro and technical headwinds that overwhelm the golden cross setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross with 15x volume spike provides technical structure, but overbought RSI/StochRSI and price below both 50/200-SMA undermine entry quality in a crisis VIX regime.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (295.5) combined with imminent CPI event in 2 days creates acute macro volatility that will likely trigger stop-loss before swing structure develops; zero fundamental conviction provides no conviction anchor.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
